title: ECC Agent IR
description: Canonical harness-neutral representation of an ECC agent, produced from a source harness definition (e.g. agents/*.md Claude frontmatter). Emitters consume this IR and produce native agent/subagent definitions per harness. The `tools` array holds source tool names verbatim (lossless); each emitter maps them through its own tool table.

id.description: Stable canonical id; the source filename stem (kebab-case).

name.description: Agent name from the source frontmatter.

description.description: Agent description from the source frontmatter.

model.description: Source model tier, when present. Claude aliases only in v1.

tools.description: Source tool names verbatim (Claude tool identifiers such as Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write, WebSearch, WebFetch, mcp__*).

color.description: Optional source-only metadata (Claude color tag); emitters may ignore it.

body.description: The agent system prompt / markdown body after the frontmatter.

frontmatter.description: Lossless raw source frontmatter for round-trip fidelity and forward compatibility.
